decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 12/04/05, the erection of a single storey detached outbuilding measuring a width of 4.5m, a depth of 6.5m and a height of 4.0m high to the top of a ridged roof, was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class E of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.
Condition : 2 - Informatives:
1		The detached single-storey outbuilding hereby found to be lawful shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the dwellinghouse known as 21 Hall Road and for no other purpose (e.g. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room or office development).
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the proposed erection of a single storey outbuilding for use as a storage/utility/playroom building to rear garden of existing house.
